attributes.name: Black Magga
attributes.powers:
Black Magga may not be evaded, and is immune to the Mental trait.

Succeed at an Arcane or Divine 14 check or your may not play spells with the Attack trait.

After the encounter, each character at this location attempts a Wisdom 9 check. Characters who succeed recharge 1d4 cards of their choice; characters who fail discard 1d4 cards of their choice.
